title: Arc Guardian — Tameion Agents Hackathon demo (v2)

scenes.caption: Arc Guardian
scenes.sub: Spending guardrails + a hash-chained decision ledger for AI agents paying USDC on Arc
scenes.narration: This is Arc Guardian. Spending guardrails, and a hash-chained decision ledger, for AI agents that pay in USDC on Arc.

scenes.caption: Give an agent a wallet and it will pay. The problem is what it pays.
bullets: An invoice that gets sent twice
A run that crashes and retries
A new supplier that is not on your vendor list
And a language model will always find a reason
Circle wallet policies exist on mainnet. On testnet there are none — and an address cap does not know what an invoice is.
scenes.narration: Give an agent a wallet and it will pay. The problem is what it pays: an invoice sent twice, a run that crashes and retries, a new supplier that is not on your vendor list. And a language model will always find a reason. On testnet there are no Circle wallet policies at all, and an address cap does not know what an invoice is.

scenes.caption: Money leaves through one door
scenes.narration: So money leaves through one door. The agent proposes a payment. A deterministic policy engine, written by the owner, never by the model, checks the vendor, the caps, duplicates, risk tier, approval threshold. Allow goes to the Circle agent wallet and settles on Arc. Hold waits for a person. Deny stops it. Every step is appended to a hash-chained ledger.

scenes.caption: Six real invoices from a one-person shop
scenes.narration: Six real invoices from my one-person shop. Three are ChatGPT, billed in Indonesian rupiah. One is Webshare. Two are proxy vendors. A sample accounts-payable agent reads them with Gemini, judges each one, and writes down why.

scenes.narration: Webshare: already paid, amount due is zero, so skip. July: the registry lists this vendor in USDC, the invoice is in rupiah, and the plan-change note does not cover July, so hold for a person. August: the amount decreased because of a verified plan change from Plus to Go, so pay. Payable invoices are converted into USDC, checked against the balance, and queued oldest first.

scenes.caption: Guardian decides. The model cannot talk past it.
output: duplicate-invoice → deny — invoice 3XLNQNBZ-0002 for openai already paid (intent inv-openai-3XLNQNBZ-0002)
possible-duplicate → hold — same vendor + same amount (4.18 USDC) paid within 14d (intent inv-openai-3XLNQNBZ-0002)
notes: Three payments settle on Arc testnet, gas paid in USDC
August sent again, same invoice number → deny: already settled
September: a new invoice, but same amount as the one just paid → hold for a person
scenes.narration: Three payments pass Guardian and settle on Arc testnet, gas paid in USDC. Then the vendor sends August again, same invoice number. The model says pay. Guardian denies it: already settled. September is a new invoice, but the same amount as the one just paid, so Guardian holds it for a person. The model cannot talk past either rule.

scenes.caption: A person lifts the hold — in one command, on the record
output: approval → allow — hold lifted by recorded approval apr_QzFjy-mf0Cn3
notes: The approval is written to the ledger, bound to (recipient, amount, currency)
Change the amount → token is void. An approval never lifts a deny.
scenes.narration: A person approves, in one command. The approval is written to the ledger and bound to the exact recipient, amount and currency. Change the amount and the token is void. The agent resubmits, Guardian allows, and it settles.

scenes.caption: explorer.testnet.arc.io — the approved payment
scenes.narration: Here it is on the Arc explorer. A Circle agent wallet, ERC-4337. Four point one eight USDC to the vendor. The fee is a fraction of a cent, paid in USDC. Arc confirmed it in under half a second.

scenes.caption: aa160999.github.io/arc-guardian — everything the agent saw and concluded
scenes.narration: Everything the agent saw and concluded is on a public page: the reasoning, which rules fired, every transaction. The page just recomputed every hash in the browser: twenty-one entries, chain intact. Edit one line after the fact, and it breaks at that entry.

scenes.caption: One business — mine. Four invoices settled, 23.48 USDC, on Arc testnet.
scenes.sub: A library, a CLI, and a worker that watches a folder  ·  github.com/aa160999/arc-guardian  ·  MIT
scenes.narration: Traction so far: one business, mine. Four invoices settled, twenty-three dollars in USDC, on Arc testnet. Guardian ships as a library, a CLI, and a worker that watches a folder. Arc Guardian. Give the agent the keys — behind a door it cannot talk its way through.
